findings.message: this says the port reads 'SR_SR_ENABLE' to turn the feature on, but the gate sets only SR_ENABLE, sr_enable: feature_enable.name, that name upper-cased, and feature_enable.macro when there is one. A port written to this plan stays off in both states, so G2 passes trivially and G3 and G5 measure nothing. Name the knob so the gate sets what the port reads, or say that the port reads one of the names above.
